entries.9edfb144e69dba1f: This is the group's core business, operating supermarkets centered on food. The company sells general foods, fresh produce, sundries and other goods at stores including 'Dio', 'La Moo' and 'The Daikokuten'. The company aims to offer 'products that are inexpensive, fresh and delicious,' and pursues the lowest prices in each area through 'ESLP (Every Day Same Low Price),' which sells at the same low price every day. In addition, it is expanding its own-brand product 'D-PRIDE,' reducing logistics costs through its in-house logistics, and improving the freshness of fresh food through temperature-controlled distribution from the production area to the store. Its growth strategy is 'high-speed multi-store expansion.' In the fiscal year ended May 2026 it opened a total of 25 stores in 16 prefectures, including Okayama, Mie and Fukuoka prefectures, and opened its first stores in Yamanashi and Oita prefectures. Of these, 7 stores are SFO stores, where 100% of products are delivered from a distribution center, which holds down opening and operating costs. The consolidated subsidiaries Value 100 Co., Ltd. (a ¥100 uniform-price discount store), Saigen Co., Ltd., Oda Shoten Co., Ltd. and Mamies Co., Ltd. also carry on the supermarket business. The group's only reportable segment is the 'Retail Business,' and segment information is omitted because its significance is low.
